title: Jets noncommittal to Cade Klubnik as QB2 after 'up and down' preseason start against Giants

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets noncommittal to Cade Klubnik as QB2 after 'up and down' preseason start against Giants
sources.description: Following his second straight mediocre preseason performance, Jets head coach Aaron Glenn was not want to anoint rookie Cade Klubnik as the team's QB2.
